purpose.label: Reduce washing frequency and intensity
purpose.description: Targeting the need to wash clothes less often and with less water by preventing them from getting dirty in the first place.

superordinate.label: Modify fabric surface properties
superordinate.description: Changing the physical characteristics of the clothing material to repel contaminants rather than removing them later.

basic.label: Apply superhydrophobic coating
basic.description: Creating a protective layer on the fabric that causes liquids and dirt to bead up and roll off.

subordinate.label: Nanostructured detergents or finishes
subordinate.description: Specific additives put into detergents or fabric finishes that utilize nanostructures to create the coating.

idea: Develop laundry detergents or fabric finishes that apply a nanostructured, superhydrophobic coating to clothes. This makes garments inherently resistant to stains and dirt adhesion, causing spills to bead up and roll off, thus requiring less frequent and less intensive washing with water.

purpose.label: Dirt removal without water solvent
purpose.description: The specific intervention point is to remove soil and contaminants from fabric without relying on water as the liquid carrier.

superordinate.label: Replacing aqueous solvents with phase-change fluids
superordinate.description: The underlying logic is using a substance that can act as a liquid-like solvent under pressure but revert to a gas for easy separation and recovery, eliminating the need for water consumption.

basic.label: Supercritical fluid cleaning cycle
basic.description: The core mechanism involves pressurizing a gas until it reaches a supercritical state where it can dissolve dirt like a liquid, then depressurizing it to recover the clean gas.

subordinate.label: Recycled supercritical CO2
subordinate.description: The specific material implementation uses Carbon Dioxide (CO2) within a sealed, pressurized chamber system.

idea: A home appliance that uses recycled supercritical CO2 as the primary cleaning agent. Clothes are placed in a sealed chamber, CO2 is pressurized to its supercritical state, dissolves dirt, then is depressurized back to a gas for collection and reuse.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via microscopic agitation
purpose.description: To dislodge dirt and contaminants from fabric fibers without relying on large volumes of water for mechanical tumbling.

superordinate.label: High-frequency energy transfer
superordinate.description: Utilizing rapid pressure fluctuations in a liquid medium to create physical force at a microscopic scale, replacing macro-scale mechanical friction.

basic.label: Ultrasonic cavitation
basic.description: The generation of intense microscopic bubbles and shockwaves through high-frequency sound waves to agitate a minimal liquid volume.

subordinate.label: Ultrasonic transducers
subordinate.description: The specific hardware devices used to generate the high-frequency sound waves within the drum.

idea: Design a washing machine drum where clothes are exposed to a minimal amount of water (or a specialized cleaning solution), which is then agitated by powerful ultrasonic transducers. This intense cavitation provides deep cleaning with significantly less water and mechanical friction than traditional methods.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via moisture
purpose.description: To release and capture dirt particles from fabric without full immersion.

superordinate.label: Phase-change cleaning cycle
superordinate.description: Using water in a dispersed state (vapor/mist) to maximize surface area contact and then reclaiming it via condensation to separate contaminants.

basic.label: Misting and Condensation Loop
basic.description: A closed system that humidifies clothes with a fine mist to loosen dirt and subsequently condenses the moisture to collect and filter out the waste.

subordinate.label: Sealed cabinet with eco-agents
subordinate.description: A laundry cabinet utilizing eco-friendly cleaning agents within the mist.

idea: A sealed laundry cabinet that cleans and refreshes clothes using a fine mist of water combined with eco-friendly cleaning agents. The mist humidifies and helps release dirt particles, which are then condensed, collected, and filtered, effectively cleaning with very low water usage per cycle.

purpose.label: Extending wear time between washes
purpose.description: Targeting the frequency of washing by sanitizing garments and removing odors so they do not need full laundering as often.

superordinate.label: Waterless chemical breakdown and sanitation
superordinate.description: Using a reactive medium to decompose organic compounds (odors) and kill bacteria without requiring liquid water as a solvent.

basic.label: Cold plasma exposure
basic.description: Exposing fabric to ionized gas (cold plasma) to break down odor-causing compounds and sanitize the material.

subordinate.label: Cold plasma generator in laundry appliance
subordinate.description: Integration of the plasma generation unit directly into a washing machine or dryer form factor.

subordinate.label: Dedicated garment cabinet
subordinate.description: A standalone enclosure designed specifically for hanging clothes for plasma treatment.

idea: Integrate a cold plasma generator into a laundry appliance or a dedicated garment cabinet. Clothes are exposed to plasma, which effectively breaks down odor-causing compounds and sanitizes the fabric, extending wear time between full washes and significantly reducing water consumption.

purpose.label: Avoiding Full-Garment Washing
purpose.description: The intervention point is to eliminate the need to wash the entire garment when only specific parts are dirty.

superordinate.label: Localized Targeting
superordinate.description: The strategic principle is restricting cleaning resources (energy, water, mechanics) solely to the contaminated areas rather than the whole surface.

basic.label: Spot-Specific Detection and Cleaning
basic.description: The core mechanism identifies specific areas of dirt or stains and applies cleaning action only to those coordinates.

subordinate.label: Optical Sensors and Micro-Brushes/Dosing
subordinate.description: Concrete implementation using optical sensors to find dirt and robotic applicators for micro-doses of solution or dry brushing.

idea: A smart robotic system, integrated into a laundry hamper or closet, that uses optical sensors to detect stains and dirt. It then applies a micro-dose of targeted cleaning solution or uses a dry micro-brush to remove localized grime, minimizing the need for full-garment, water-intensive washing.

purpose.label: Extend wash intervals for lightly soiled items
purpose.description: Reducing the frequency of full water washes by targeting garments that only need refreshing rather than deep cleaning.

superordinate.label: Non-aqueous biological neutralization
superordinate.description: Replacing physical removal of contaminants via water solvent with in-situ neutralization of biological agents (bacteria/odors).

basic.label: Ultraviolet germicidal irradiation
basic.description: Using short-wavelength ultraviolet (UV-C) light to kill or inactivate microorganisms and break down odor-causing compounds.

subordinate.label: UV-C chamber
subordinate.description: A specific enclosure equipped with UV-C emitting lights to hold the garments.

idea: A garment "freshener" chamber that uses UV-C light to sanitize and deodorize clothes, especially those that are not visibly dirty but need refreshing. This significantly reduces the frequency of water-intensive washes, particularly for delicate items or outerwear.

purpose.label: Dirt removal from fabric
purpose.description: Separating particulate matter and soil from the fibers of clothing.

superordinate.label: Force-based separation
superordinate.description: Utilizing physical attraction forces to manipulate particles rather than chemical dissolution or fluid transport.

basic.label: Electrostatic attraction
basic.description: Using induced static charges to attract dirt particles away from fabric toward an oppositely charged collector.

subordinate.label: Low-humidity tumbling drum with collector plate
subordinate.description: A specific drum environment designed to induce charge via tumbling and collect particles on a filter/plate.

idea: Design a laundry drum that tumbles clothes in a low-humidity environment, inducing an electrostatic charge on both fabric and dirt particles. The charged dirt particles are then attracted to an oppositely charged collector plate or filter within the drum, effectively "lifting" them off the fabric without water.

purpose.label: Water Reuse
purpose.description: To capture and treat used water from one cycle so it can be utilized again for subsequent washing loads.

superordinate.label: Closed-Loop Recycling
superordinate.description: Creating a self-contained cycle where resources are continuously recovered and recirculated rather than discarded.

basic.label: On-board Purification System
basic.description: An integrated treatment mechanism within the machine that cleans greywater to pristine quality for immediate reuse.

subordinate.label: Multi-stage filtration (Micro-filtration, RO, UV)
subordinate.description: Specific technologies used: micro-filtration, reverse osmosis, and UV sterilization.

idea: A washing machine with an integrated, ultra-efficient closed-loop water purification system. After each wash cycle, the greywater undergoes micro-filtration, reverse osmosis, and UV sterilization, making it pristine and immediately reusable for the next load, virtually eliminating water discharge and demand.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via physical displacement
purpose.description: The specific intervention point is the physical removal of embedded dirt and grime from fabrics.

superordinate.label: Phase change expansion force
superordinate.description: Exploiting the rapid expansion of a solid material turning into gas (sublimation) to generate kinetic energy for cleaning.

basic.label: Dry ice blasting / Sublimation cleaning
basic.description: Using the impact and immediate sublimation of frozen carbon dioxide pellets to dislodge contaminants without liquid water.

subordinate.label: Fine dry ice pellets
subordinate.description: The specific blasting medium used in the system.

idea: A specialized laundry treatment system where clothes are exposed to a controlled blast of fine dry ice pellets. The sublimation effect physically removes embedded dirt and grime, similar to agitation but without any water, making it ideal for certain fabrics or for quick refresh cycles where water isn't necessary.

purpose.label: Localized stain removal
purpose.description: Removing specific spots or soils from fabric without treating the entire garment.

superordinate.label: Chemical degradation of contaminants
superordinate.description: Breaking down stain structures at a molecular level into removable byproducts rather than relying on mechanical agitation or solvent dilution.

basic.label: Enzymatic decomposition and absorption
basic.description: Applying concentrated biological catalysts to break down stains followed by manual removal (wiping/absorbing) of the residue.

subordinate.label: Applicator pen with concentrated enzyme blend
subordinate.description: A pen or spray device containing a mixture of fabric-safe enzymes and an absorbent pad or cloth.

idea: A targeted spray or applicator pen that dispenses a concentrated blend of fabric-safe enzymes onto specific stains. After a short dwell time, the broken-down stain components can be wiped away with a damp cloth or absorbed by a dry, absorbent pad, eliminating the need for a full water wash for localized soiling.

purpose.label: Extending wear interval
purpose.description: Prolonging the time clothes can be worn before requiring a full wash.

superordinate.label: Contaminant sequestration
superordinate.description: Capturing and trapping airborne particulates and molecules rather than dissolving them in a solvent.

basic.label: Adsorptive air circulation
basic.description: Moving air through garments to carry contaminants into a material that captures them on its surface.

subordinate.label: Sealed garment cabinet
subordinate.description: An enclosed space where clothes are hung to contain the treatment environment.

subordinate.label: Adsorptive media (Carbon/Zeolite)
subordinate.description: Specific materials like activated carbon filters or zeolite beads used to trap odors.

idea: A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are hung. The cabinet incorporates a fan that circulates air through the garments and then through a bed of adsorptive material (e.g., activated carbon filters or zeolite beads). This system passively removes odors and fine dust particles from clothing, extending wear time between washes without using any water.

purpose.label: Waterless stain and odor removal
purpose.description: Removing contaminants like oils, dirt, and odors from fabric without using water as the primary solvent.

superordinate.label: Solid-phase extraction and abrasion
superordinate.description: Using solid media rather than liquid solvents to physically lift and chemically adsorb contaminants from surfaces.

basic.label: Reusable absorbent granule tumbling
basic.description: A process where clothes are tumbled with small, reusable solid granules that mechanically abrade fabric while absorbing oils and dirt.

subordinate.label: Cryogel granules
subordinate.description: Specific material used for the granules: tiny, reusable cryogel particles.

idea: A specialized tumbling drum system where clothes are cleaned with a mixture of tiny, reusable cryogel granules. These granules gently abrade the fabric, absorbing oils, dirt, and odor molecules. After the cycle, the granules are separated from the clothes, cleaned (e.g., by vacuuming or solvent bath), and reused, with no water used in the garment cleaning process itself.

purpose.label: Mechanical soil removal
purpose.description: To dislodge dirt and contaminants from fabric fibers without relying on large volumes of solvent.

superordinate.label: Micro-scale fluid dynamics
superordinate.description: Utilizing the high-energy properties of fluid movement at a microscopic scale to maximize cleaning force per unit of water.

basic.label: Acoustic streaming scrubbing
basic.description: Generating steady fluid flow and shear forces (streaming) within a thin liquid film using sound waves to create scrubbing action.

subordinate.label: Transducers and micro-channels
subordinate.description: Transducers acting on water in micro-channels or textured surfaces.

idea: A washing device designed with micro-channels or textured surfaces where clothes are exposed to a very thin film of water or cleaning solution. Transducers generate targeted acoustic streaming within this film, creating microscopic "scrubbing" action that cleans fabric at a surface level with significantly reduced water volume compared to traditional methods.

purpose.label: Removal of odor and organic soils
purpose.description: Targeting the specific sub-problem of eliminating odor-causing compounds and light organic debris from fabrics.

superordinate.label: Biological degradation
superordinate.description: Leveraging biological agents to break down unwanted substances naturally rather than washing them away with mechanical force or chemical solvents.

basic.label: Microbial digestion
basic.description: Using beneficial microbes to metabolize and consume dirt and odor molecules.

subordinate.label: Mist-based microbial application
subordinate.description: Introducing fabric-safe microbes via a fine mist within a controlled cabinet or low-humidity chamber.

idea: A controlled environment cabinet or low-humidity wash chamber that introduces a fine mist containing beneficial, fabric-safe microbes. These microbes, under optimal conditions of temperature and humidity, "consume" odor-causing compounds and light organic soiling on garments, effectively cleaning them over a gentle, longer cycle with minimal water input.

purpose.label: Removal of dry particulates and surface debris
purpose.description: Targeting the specific sub-problem of extracting non-adhered contaminants like dust, lint, and hair to clean fabric without water.

superordinate.label: Pneumatic extraction via negative pressure
superordinate.description: The principle of using suction (air pressure differential) to physically dislodge and transport loose matter away from surfaces.

basic.label: Vacuum suction system
basic.description: The mechanism of applying active suction through nozzles to lift and extract dirt from fabric while it is tumbled.

subordinate.label: High-efficiency vacuum nozzles
subordinate.description: Specific hardware interfaces used to apply the suction.

subordinate.label: Brushes
subordinate.description: Mechanical aids mentioned alongside the vacuum nozzles to assist in cleaning.

subordinate.label: Laundry drum / chamber
subordinate.description: The container where the tumbling action occurs during the vacuum process.

idea: A laundry drum or chamber equipped with high-efficiency vacuum nozzles and brushes. Clothes are tumbled while a powerful vacuum system actively lifts and extracts dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial dry dirt from the fabric. This process also helps remove airborne particles and can extend the life of garments between full wet washes.

purpose.label: Odor and contaminant removal
purpose.description: Targeting the specific sub-problem of breaking down odor molecules and airborne contaminants to refresh garments without washing.

superordinate.label: Oxidative degradation
superordinate.description: Using chemical oxidation reactions to break down complex organic pollutants into harmless byproducts.

basic.label: Photocatalytic oxidation (PCO)
basic.description: A process where light energy activates a catalyst to create oxidative reactions that decompose organic matter.

subordinate.label: TiO2 catalyst and UV-A light
subordinate.description: The specific implementation using Titanium Dioxide surfaces activated by UV-A light sources inside a cabinet.

idea: A garment "freshener" cabinet with internal surfaces coated with a TiO2 catalyst and equipped with UV-A light sources. Clothes are hung inside, and the PCO process continuously breaks down odor molecules and airborne contaminants, providing a dry, chemical-free, and water-free method for refreshing garments and extending wear.

purpose.label: Dirt and oil extraction
purpose.description: Removing contaminants like body oils and dissolved grime from garment fibers without bulk washing.

superordinate.label: Contact-based absorption
superordinate.description: Using a highly absorbent external medium to pull contaminants out of a target surface through direct physical contact.

basic.label: Capillary action transfer
basic.description: Active wicking of moisture and grime from garment fibers into a secondary material driven by surface tension forces.

subordinate.label: Impregnated wicking sheets
subordinate.description: Disposable or reusable sheets treated with cleaning agents placed in a drum or cabinet.

idea: Disposable or reusable "wicking sheets" impregnated with a small amount of cleaning agent that are placed inside or alongside garments in a low-humidity tumbling drum or dedicated cabinet. These sheets actively draw moisture, body oils, and dissolved grime out of the garment fibers through capillary action, trapping them within the sheet and refreshing the clothing with minimal to no external water.

purpose.label: Stain and dirt removal
purpose.description: The specific intervention point is removing embedded contaminants like dirt and gum from fabric.

superordinate.label: Embrittlement for separation
superordinate.description: Exploiting the physical property change where cooling reduces flexibility and adhesion, making contaminants easier to break off.

basic.label: Cryogenic thermal shock
basic.description: Briefly chilling the target material to extremely low temperatures to alter the physical state of contaminants.

basic.label: Mechanical dislodgement
basic.description: Using physical force to remove the now-brittle contaminants from the fabric.

subordinate.label: Chilled air blast or Liquid nitrogen vapor
subordinate.description: The specific cooling agents used to achieve cryogenic temperatures.

subordinate.label: Vibration or Brushing
subordinate.description: The specific mechanical actions used to shake off the brittle dirt.

idea: A specialized garment cleaning chamber that briefly chills clothes to cryogenic temperatures (e.g., using a controlled blast of chilled air or liquid nitrogen vapor). This causes embedded dirt, chewing gum, or stubborn stains to become brittle, allowing them to be easily dislodged and vibrated or brushed off the fabric without the need for water or solvents.

purpose.label: Greywater recycling
purpose.description: Treating and reusing water from wash cycles to minimize fresh water intake.

superordinate.label: Contaminant aggregation
superordinate.description: Forcing dispersed particles to clump together to facilitate easier removal from the liquid.

basic.label: Electrocoagulation
basic.description: Using electrical charges to destabilize suspended particles (dirt, dyes), causing them to coagulate for removal.

subordinate.label: Electrocoagulation system
subordinate.description: The specific hardware integrated into the washing machine's water purification loop.

idea: An advanced washing machine that incorporates an electrocoagulation system into its water purification loop. After a minimal initial wash with water, the greywater is treated with electrocoagulation to rapidly aggregate and remove dirt, dyes, and other contaminants. This pre-treatment significantly reduces the load on subsequent filtration, allowing the water to be recycled and reused much more efficiently for consecutive washes, minimizing fresh water intake.

purpose.label: Removal of dry particulate soil
purpose.description: Targeting the extraction of loose debris like dust, lint, and hair from fabric fibers.

superordinate.label: Mechanical displacement via fluid dynamics
superordinate.description: Using physical force generated by a fluid medium to dislodge and transport contaminants away from a surface.

basic.label: High-velocity air vortex generation
basic.description: Creating controlled, swirling air currents to generate aerodynamic lift and carrying force.

subordinate.label: Precisely positioned nozzles
subordinate.description: Specific hardware configuration used to direct airflow within the chamber.

idea: A specialized laundry chamber or drum designed with precisely positioned nozzles that generate high-velocity, controlled air vortices around and through the garments. These aerodynamic forces would gently lift and carry away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial particulate dirt from fabric fibers, collecting them in a filter system, effectively de-soiling clothes without any water.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal
purpose.description: To physically separate and remove dirt, oils, and odors from fabric fibers.

superordinate.label: Force-mediated extraction
superordinate.description: Utilizing an external field or force to remotely manipulate and extract specific target particles without liquid flushing.

basic.label: Magnetic adhesion and retrieval
basic.description: Introducing dirt-binding magnetic agents that can be forcibly removed from the substrate using magnetic fields.

subordinate.label: Microscopic magnetic particles & Oscillating field
subordinate.description: Microscopic fabric-safe magnetic particles (mist or powder) and an oscillating magnetic field used to pull particles into a collection chamber.

idea: Develop a cleaning system that introduces microscopic, fabric-safe magnetic particles (e.g., in a fine mist or dry powder form) engineered to selectively adhere to dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on garments. After a brief tumbling period to ensure contact, a powerful, oscillating magnetic field is applied to pull these dirt-laden magnetic particles out of the fabric and into a collection chamber for separation and potential reuse.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via agitation
purpose.description: Dislodging dirt and impurities from fabric without relying on large volumes of water for mechanical tumbling.

superordinate.label: Two-phase flow cleaning
superordinate.description: Using a gaseous phase moving through a liquid phase to generate mechanical shear forces and turbulence directly at the fabric surface.

basic.label: Pulsed bubble percolation
basic.description: Introducing controlled, pulsed streams of gas bubbles that rise through the fabric to create a scrubbing action.

subordinate.label: Diffusers and inert gas
subordinate.description: A system of diffusers injecting fine air or inert gas bubbles into a low-surface-tension solution.

idea: Design a cleaning chamber where clothes are gently suspended in a minimal volume of water or a specialized, low-surface-tension cleaning solution. A system of diffusers beneath the garments introduces precisely controlled, pulsed streams of fine air or inert gas bubbles. These bubbles percolate through the fabric, creating a gentle "scrubbing" action that dislodges dirt and impurities, which are then collected from the circulating minimal liquid.

purpose.label: Dirt and Water Extraction
purpose.description: To remove water containing dissolved dirt and oils from within fabric fibers.

superordinate.label: Chemical Potential Gradient
superordinate.description: Utilizing a difference in concentration between the fabric environment and the external medium to drive mass transfer.

basic.label: Osmotic Pressure Separation
basic.description: Drawing liquid (and contaminants) out of fabric by placing it in contact with a medium that has higher osmotic pressure.

subordinate.label: Highly Concentrated Cleaning Solution
subordinate.description: A non-toxic liquid solution with high solute concentration used to create osmotic pressure.

subordinate.label: Solid Osmotic Agent
subordinate.description: A solid material capable of inducing osmotic pressure to draw out water.

idea: A low-water garment cleaning system utilizing a highly concentrated, non-toxic cleaning solution or a solid osmotic agent. Garments are placed in contact with this agent or solution, and due to the osmotic pressure difference, water (containing dissolved dirt and body oils from the fabric fibers) is drawn out of the fabric and into the concentrated medium, effectively cleaning the garment with minimal external water.

purpose.label: Dry sanitization and deodorization of fabrics
purpose.description: Targeting the removal of odors and microbial contaminants from clothes without using water.

superordinate.label: Chemical oxidation of contaminants
superordinate.description: Utilizing reactive agents to break down organic molecules and biological structures at a molecular level.

basic.label: Plasma-generated reactive species exposure
basic.description: Generating ozone and reactive oxygen/nitrogen species via plasma discharge to interact with fabric surfaces.

subordinate.label: Garment refreshing cabinet with DBD generator
subordinate.description: A specific enclosure utilizing a dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) generator to produce the necessary plasma environment.

idea: A garment refreshing cabinet equipped with a DBD plasma generator. Clothes are exposed to the ozone and reactive oxygen/nitrogen species produced by the DBD. These species effectively break down odor molecules, volatile organic compounds, and microbial contaminants on the fabric surface without direct contact, heat, or water, providing dry sanitization and deodorization.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via ion migration
purpose.description: Removing charged impurities and dirt particles from fabric using a fluid medium.

superordinate.label: Electrokinetic separation
superordinate.description: Exploiting the movement of charged particles in an electric field to separate contaminants from a substrate without mechanical agitation or high solvent volume.

basic.label: Electrodialysis extraction
basic.description: Applying an electric current across ion-exchange membranes to actively pull charged dirt particles out of the fabric and into a waste stream.

subordinate.label: Alternating ion-exchange membranes
subordinate.description: A chamber configuration using alternating cation and anion exchange membranes with a weak electrolyte solution.

idea: A specialized washing unit where clothes are suspended in a minimal amount of slightly conductive water or a weak electrolyte solution. The chamber incorporates alternating cation and anion exchange membranes. By applying an electric current, charged dirt particles (ions) and dissolved impurities are drawn out of the fabric and across the membranes, leaving cleaner fabric and significantly purified water for near-complete reuse within the closed system.

purpose.label: Expel dirt from fabric pores
purpose.description: The removal of trapped dirt, grime, and impurities from within the porous structure of the fabric.

superordinate.label: Micro-mechanical displacement
superordinate.description: The strategy of using physical force generated at a microscopic level to dislodge and eject contaminants, rather than relying on solvent flow.

basic.label: Stimuli-responsive volumetric cycle
basic.description: A process where materials undergo reversible swelling and contraction when triggered, generating physical movement to push out and squeeze away impurities.

subordinate.label: Smart polymers triggered by temperature/pH
subordinate.description: Specific cleaning agents or coatings made of smart polymers that react to thermal or chemical triggers in a low-humidity environment.

idea: Develop cleaning agents or fabric coatings containing embedded or surface-applied smart polymers. When triggered (e.g., by a slight temperature change or pH adjustment in a low-humidity chamber with minimal mist), these polymers swell, physically pushing dirt and grime out of the fabric pores. Upon a reverse trigger, they contract, squeezing out any trapped impurities or dirty water, which is then collected, significantly reducing water usage for cleaning and rinsing.

purpose.label: Detach dirt from fabric fibers
purpose.description: The specific intervention of loosening and separating particulate matter from the textile structure.

superordinate.label: Physical bond disruption via resonance
superordinate.description: Exploiting specific energy frequencies to break the physical adhesion between contaminants and substrate without solvents.

basic.label: Tuned frequency application
basic.description: Applying precise mechanical or sonic oscillations that match the resonant frequency of dirt-fabric bonds.

subordinate.label: Sonic frequencies and Vacuum collection
subordinate.description: Specific use of sonic frequencies to loosen dirt and vacuum/filtration systems to collect the debris.

idea: A garment cleaning chamber that exposes clothes to precisely tuned mechanical vibrations or sonic frequencies. These frequencies are engineered to resonate with the physical bonds between dirt particles and fabric fibers, effectively loosening and detaching dirt without requiring bulk water. The dislodged particles are then collected by a vacuum or filtration system.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via surface interaction
purpose.description: The specific sub-problem of dislodging dirt and oils from fabric without submerging the garment in a large volume of water.

superordinate.label: Localized fluid shear forces
superordinate.description: The strategic principle of generating high shear stress at the fabric-fluid interface to mechanically 'peel' dirt away using minimal fluid volume.

basic.label: Thin-film micro-channel flow
basic.description: A mechanism where a very thin, continuously flowing film of water moves across a textured or micro-channel surface to create cleaning action on flat or gently rolled garments.

subordinate.label: Textured internal surface / Micro-channels
subordinate.description: The specific physical geometry used to guide the thin water film and generate the necessary shear forces.

idea: A washing device featuring a textured internal surface or specialized micro-channels. Garments are laid flat or gently rolled across this surface while a very thin, continuously flowing film of water or cleaning solution is introduced. The micro-scale geometry of the surface generates localized fluid shear forces that effectively "peel" and dislodge surface dirt and oils from the fabric with an extremely low volume of liquid, which is then filtered and recirculated.

purpose.label: Waterless contaminant removal
purpose.description: Removing oils, grime, and contaminants from fabric without consuming water resources.

superordinate.label: Non-aqueous phase-change solubility
superordinate.description: Exploiting the ability of a chemical medium to dissolve contaminants by shifting between vapor and liquid states on the target surface.

basic.label: Re-circulating solvent vapor cycle
basic.description: A process where solvent vapor condenses on cooler fabric to dissolve dirt and then re-evaporates to carry contaminants away.

subordinate.label: Low-boiling-point solvent (alcohol or fluorocarbon)
subordinate.description: Specific cleaning agents used, such as modified alcohol or fluorocarbon, characterized by low boiling points.

idea: A compact garment cleaning appliance that uses a targeted, re-circulating vapor of a fabric-safe, low-boiling-point solvent (e.g., a modified alcohol or fluorocarbon). Clothes, or specific stained areas, are exposed to this vapor. The vapor condenses on the cooler fabric, dissolves oils and grime, and then re-evaporates, carrying the contaminants away to a recovery and purification system, leaving no residue and requiring no water for the cleaning process.

purpose.label: Remove contaminants without mechanical agitation
purpose.description: To separate dirt and oil particles from fabric fibers using minimal fluid and avoiding physical scrubbing.

superordinate.label: Electrophoretic migration
superordinate.description: Exploiting the intrinsic electrical charge of contaminant particles to move them through a medium via an external field.

basic.label: Electric field-driven particle scavenging
basic.description: Applying an oscillating electric field across a conductive liquid film to force charged dirt particles to migrate toward collectors.

subordinate.label: Conductive film and collector electrodes
subordinate.description: Fabric-safe conductive liquid film (mild electrolyte) and specialized electrodes or permeable membranes.

idea: A laundry chamber designed to expose garments to a very thin, fabric-safe, conductive liquid film (e.g., minimal water with a mild electrolyte). An oscillating electric field is applied across the fabric. Dirt and oil particles, which often carry a net electrical charge, are made to migrate through the liquid film towards specialized collector electrodes or a permeable membrane, effectively "scavenging" them off the fabric with significantly less water and no mechanical scrubbing.

purpose.label: Removal of dry particulates and surface grime
purpose.description: Targeting the mechanical removal of loose debris like dust, lint, and hair from fabric surfaces without wetting.

superordinate.label: Dry adhesive capture
superordinate.description: Exploiting surface adhesion properties to mechanically lift contaminants from fabric without chemical solvents or fluid transport.

basic.label: Gecko-inspired micro-structure contact
basic.description: Using a surface with micro- or nano-structures that mimics gecko feet to create directional adhesion for picking up dirt and releasing it upon adjustment.

subordinate.label: Specialized roller or pad
subordinate.description: The specific form factor containing the adhesive surface.

subordinate.label: Handheld device or automated robotic system
subordinate.description: The mechanism used to pass the cleaning surface over the garments.

idea: A handheld device or an automated robotic system with a specialized roller or pad whose surface mimics the micro- or nano-structure of gecko feet. This roller would be gently passed over garments, picking up dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime through contact. The collected dirt would then be released from the roller's surface into a waste receptacle (e.g., by a slight change in angle or pressure), allowing the cleaning surface to be reused repeatedly without water or chemicals.

purpose.label: Waterless debris removal
purpose.description: To dislodge and remove dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from fabric fibers without using liquid.

superordinate.label: Mechanical agitation via energy conversion
superordinate.description: Exploiting the conversion of macroscopic kinetic energy (tumbling) into microscopic mechanical energy to break particle adhesion.

basic.label: Piezoelectric micro-vibration
basic.description: Inducing high-frequency micro-vibrations directly within the fabric structure using the piezoelectric effect triggered by tumbling motion.

basic.label: Air-based extraction
basic.description: Using suction and filtration to collect dislodged particles from the environment.

subordinate.label: Embedded piezoelectric fibers
subordinate.description: Fibers woven into garments or liners that generate charge/vibration under stress.

subordinate.label: Dry tumbling drum
subordinate.description: The vessel providing the gentle mechanical motion required to activate the piezoelectric effect.

subordinate.label: Integrated vacuum and filter system
subordinate.description: The specific mechanism installed within the drum to capture the loosened dirt.

idea: Develop garments or specialized fabric liners with embedded or woven piezoelectric fibers. When these garments are placed in a dry tumbling drum, the gentle mechanical motion of tumbling induces micro-vibrations within the fabric itself (due to the piezoelectric effect). These self-generated, high-frequency vibrations effectively loosen and dislodge dry dirt, dust, and lint particles from the fibers, which are then collected by an integrated vacuum and filter system within the drum, eliminating the need for water for general refreshing.

purpose.label: Remove moisture and fabric contaminants
purpose.description: Targeting the extraction of body oils, odors, and moisture trapped within garments without traditional washing.

superordinate.label: Adsorptive mass transfer
superordinate.description: Exploiting the chemical affinity of sorbent materials to pull moisture and contaminants out of fabrics and into a collection medium.

basic.label: Regenerable desiccant air loop

The desiccant actively pulls moisture (and dissolved body oils/odors) directly from the fabric into the air stream, and then adsorbs it. This dry extraction process cleanses and deodorizes garments without the use of water. The desiccant can then be heated to release the dirty moisture for disposal and regenerate for reuse.

idea: A specialized enclosed chamber where garments are suspended and gently agitated by powerful, non-audible ultrasonic standing waves. This contactless "tumbling" and manipulation effectively loosens dry dirt, dust, and lint from the fabric fibers. A gentle filtered airflow simultaneously draws away the dislodged particles into a collection system, providing a dry, contact-free cleaning and refreshing process without any water or mechanical wear on the fabric.

purpose.label: Soil Removal via Mechanical Stress

basic.label: Filtration-based Reclamation

idea: A system where garments are briefly immersed in a minimal volume of a low-viscosity, fabric-safe MR fluid. A pulsed magnetic field is then applied, causing the fluid to momentarily thicken around the fabric fibers, effectively encapsulating and mechanically stressing embedded dirt and oil particles. When the field is removed, the fluid instantly thins, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then carried away by filtration. The fluid is continuously recycled and purified for subsequent uses with minimal loss and no water.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal from fabric

superordinate.label: Solid-phase extraction via preferential affinity

basic.label: Absorbent contact transfer

subordinate.label: Superhydrophilic textured sheet/pad

idea: A specialized, highly reusable sheet or pad made from a superhydrophilic, finely textured material designed to be placed in a tumbling dryer or a dedicated refresh cabinet with clothes. During a brief cycle with a very fine, minimal mist of water, this sheet actively attracts and captures body oils, dissolved dirt, and fine particulate matter released from the garments. The superhydrophilic material "wicks" and holds these contaminants, effectively cleaning the clothes with minimal water, and the sheet is then rinsed clean for reuse.

purpose.label: Remove dirt and odor molecules from fabric

superordinate.label: Adhesion-based physical extraction

basic.label: Triggered adhesive shedding

subordinate.label: Hydrogel-based bio-slime and pH/vibration triggers
subordinate.description: Specific implementation using a biodegradable polymer mist, released via pH changes or vibration.

idea: A controlled chamber system that applies a fine, non-toxic, biodegradable, and fabric-safe "bio-slime" (e.g., a hydrogel-based polymer with specific adhesive properties) mist onto clothes. This slime is engineered to be slightly adhesive to dirt and odor molecules. After a short dwell time, a second stage triggers a controlled 'shedding' or breakdown of the slime (e.g., via a pH change or mild vibration), causing it to detach from the fabric, carrying the trapped dirt and odors with it, into a collection system. The slime is then processed for disposal or regeneration, leaving clean, residue-free clothes with minimal water usage.

purpose.label: Remove organic contaminants from fabric

This plasma generates energetic reactive species tuned to gently react with and break down organic residues (body oils, odors, superficial grime) on the fabric surface. These contaminants are converted into volatile byproducts that are then vacuumed away, providing a deep, dry clean at a molecular level without water or harsh chemicals, thereby extending garment life.

purpose.label: Dirt removal without bulk water volume

superordinate.label: Directed particle manipulation

basic.label: Closed-loop filtration

subordinate.label: High-frequency acoustic transducers

idea: A minimal-water wash system where clothes are immersed in a very small volume of water containing a low concentration of cleaning agents. High-frequency acoustic transducers are precisely arrayed to generate acoustic radiation forces that gently 'push' and aggregate dirt particles within the water towards a specific collection zone or filter, without requiring bulk fluid flow or mechanical agitation of the clothes. This allows for highly efficient dirt removal from the water, enabling near-complete water recirculation and minimal fresh water input for effective cleaning.

purpose.label: Dirt removal without liquid extraction

superordinate.label: Phase change extraction
superordinate.description: Exploiting the physical transition of a cleaning medium from solid to gas to carry away contaminants.

basic.label: Sublimation cleaning
basic.description: Freezing a wetted cleaning agent and subjecting it to low pressure to cause sublimation, lifting dirt away as gas.

subordinate.label: Chilled air freezing and low-pressure chamber
subordinate.description: Using chilled air to freeze the wetted garment and a low-pressure chamber to induce sublimation.

idea: Garments are exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water and a cleaning agent, just enough to lightly wet the fabric and encapsulate dirt. The wetted garment is then gently frozen (e.g., with chilled air) and placed in a low-pressure chamber. The frozen cleaning solution and dirt sublimate away, removing contaminants directly from the fabric structure without liquid drainage or mechanical stress, resulting in clean, dry clothes with minimal water usage.

purpose.label: Remove dry contaminants from fabric

superordinate.label: Physical detachment via surface friction

basic.label: Pneumatic extraction

subordinate.label: Micro-bristles and combs

subordinate.label: Integrated vacuum system

idea: Design a laundry appliance with a rotating drum or series of pads equipped with precisely engineered, fabric-safe micro-bristles and combs, mimicking insect grooming structures. As clothes tumble or pass through, these structures gently brush, comb, and scrape away dry dust, lint, pet hair, and superficial grime from fabric fibers, collecting them in an integrated vacuum system, thus cleaning without water.

purpose.label: Water recycling

superordinate.label: Phase-change separation
superordinate.description: Separating pure water from contaminants by converting the water into a different state of matter (vapor) while leaving impurities behind.

basic.label: Membrane distillation

subordinate.label: Hydrophobic membrane unit

idea: A washing machine integrated with a membrane distillation unit. After an initial minimal-water wash, the greywater is fed into the membrane distillation system. Water vapor passes through the hydrophobic membrane, leaving all dissolved and suspended contaminants in the concentrated brine. This purified water is then condensed and immediately recycled for the next wash cycle, achieving ultra-high water recovery and significantly reducing fresh water intake.

purpose.label: Wash frequency reduction
purpose.description: Extending the time interval between full water washes by maintaining garment freshness during use.

superordinate.label: Material-integrated self-maintenance
superordinate.description: Embedding the cleaning capability directly into the fabric structure to allow for local, autonomous maintenance without external water baths.

basic.label: Stress-triggered encapsulated release

subordinate.label: Microcapsules and mechanical stress

idea: Garments are manufactured with embedded, fabric-safe microcapsules containing a concentrated, low-water cleaning agent or odor neutralizer. When the garment is worn or experiences mild mechanical stress (e.g., gentle tumbling in a refresh cabinet with slight humidity), some capsules burst, releasing their contents to spot-clean, remove odors, or refresh the fabric locally, significantly extending the time between full water washes.

purpose.label: Waterless odor removal

superordinate.label: Selective molecular capture

basic.label: Regenerable chemical adsorption

subordinate.label: Modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs)

idea: A garment refreshing cabinet that utilizes a bed of regenerable, fabric-safe chemical sorbents (e.g., modified amines or Metal-Organic Frameworks). These sorbents are specifically engineered to reversibly bind volatile organic compounds (VOCs) responsible for odors. Air is circulated through the garments and then over the sorbent bed, trapping odors. The sorbent is then periodically regenerated (e.g., by heating or pressure swing), releasing concentrated odors for safe disposal, making this a highly efficient, water-free, and chemical-free deodorization system.

purpose.label: Stain removal

superordinate.label: Localized fluid manipulation

basic.label: Electric field droplet actuation

subordinate.label: Electrodes and specialized nozzles

idea: A flat or slightly curved surface where garments are laid. A system of precise nozzles applies micro-droplets of a specialized, low-surface-tension cleaning solution to stained areas. Electrodes beneath the surface then apply electric fields to dynamically move, oscillate, or "scrub" these droplets over the fabric, dislodging dirt. The dirty droplets are then electro-wetting-guided to a collection port, allowing for extremely targeted cleaning with minuscule water usage.

purpose.label: Particulate adhesion breaking

purpose.label: Dislodged particle removal

superordinate.label: Fluid transport

basic.label: Broadband mechanical vibration
basic.description: The application of a spectrum of mechanical waves (compressional and shear) to physically agitate fibers and shatter dirt adhesion.

basic.label: Pneumatic conveyance
basic.description: The use of airflow to sweep away loose particles after they have been mechanically dislodged.

subordinate.label: Multi-modal transducers

subordinate.label: Airflow and filtration system

idea: A garment cleaning chamber equipped with multi-modal transducers capable of generating a broadband spectrum of mechanical waves, including both compressional and shear waves, that propagate through the fabric. These complex vibrations are designed to physically agitate and break the adhesion of diverse dirt particles (dry dust, sticky grime) from fibers across various fabric types. Dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving dry cleaning without specific reliance on a single resonance.

purpose.label: Prevent odor development

superordinate.label: Metabolic suppression
superordinate.description: Creating an environment that deprives biological agents (bacteria/fungi) of essential resources needed for growth and activity.

basic.label: Hypoxic atmosphere control

subordinate.label: Smart wardrobe / Garment cabinet

idea: A smart wardrobe or garment cabinet that maintains a precisely controlled, low-oxygen (hypoxic) internal atmosphere. By reducing the oxygen concentration around garments, the growth and metabolic activity of odor-causing bacteria and fungi are significantly inhibited, effectively preventing the development of unpleasant smells and extending the freshness of clothes without washing or chemical deodorizers, thus reducing water usage.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via physical detachment

superordinate.label: Photomechanical energy transfer
superordinate.description: Using light energy to induce mechanical forces in a solid medium to dislodge contaminants.

basic.label: Laser-activated micro-abrasion
basic.description: A system where laser energy interacts with dry micro-particles to create localized mechanical action that lifts dirt.

subordinate.label: Biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads)
subordinate.description: The specific dry medium used to interact with the laser.

subordinate.label: Low-power pulsed laser beam
subordinate.description: The specific light source used to energize the particles.

idea: A garment cleaning system where a very fine, dry, and biodegradable micro-abrasive powder (e.g., cellulose beads) is gently dusted onto clothes. A precisely controlled, low-power pulsed laser beam then scans the fabric. The laser energy interacts with the micro-abrasive particles, causing them to gently 'lift' or 'etch' away dirt and grime from the fabric surface through localized photomechanical action. The dirty micro-abrasive is then vacuumed away, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal

superordinate.label: Molecular decomposition

basic.label: Electrochemical oxidation

subordinate.label: Electrodes and electrolyte film

idea: A targeted handheld device or a small chamber with specialized electrodes. Garments, or specific soiled areas, are exposed to a minimal film of a slightly conductive, fabric-safe electrolyte solution. An electric current is then precisely applied, generating reactive species or directly oxidizing organic dirt, stains, and odor molecules on the fabric surface. These contaminants are electrochemically degraded into simpler, water-soluble, or volatile compounds, which are then wiped away or evaporated, minimizing water usage and avoiding harsh chemicals.

purpose.label: Dirt and odor removal without liquid washing
purpose.description: Removing contaminants from fabric fibers without submerging them in a liquid bath.

superordinate.label: Phase-based mass transfer
superordinate.description: Exploiting the ability of gaseous or vapor-phase carriers to penetrate porous materials and transport adsorbed contaminants away from a solid substrate.

basic.label: Gas-phase chemical desorption (Chromatographic elution)
basic.description: A process where a carrier gas containing a specific binding agent flows through the fabric, selectively binding to dirt molecules and carrying them out to a recovery unit.

subordinate.label: Recycled carrier gas with non-toxic binding agent
subordinate.description: A specific mixture of a carrier gas and a fabric-safe agent that vaporizes and is continuously purified for reuse.

This agent selectively vaporizes, diffuses into the fabric, adsorbs to dirt and odor molecules, and then is carried away by the gas stream to a separation and recovery unit. The carrier gas and binding agent are continuously purified and reused, effectively "chromatographically eluting" dirt and odors from the fabric without water.

purpose.label: Dirt Adhesion Removal

subordinate.description: The specific physical effect generated by the thermal expansion/contraction.

subordinate.description: The mechanism used to collect the detached dirt.

This generates micro-scale mechanical shockwaves that break the adhesive bonds of dirt particles, which are then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration, providing a contactless, water-free cleaning method.

purpose.label: Remove contaminants from fabric

A secondary, integrated mechanism continuously cleans the rollers (e.g., with a scraper or micro-solvent spray which is then recovered), enabling continuous dirt removal from clothes without water.

purpose.label: Dislodge dirt without solvent

subordinate.description: Specific electromagnetic frequencies used to target the dirt.

subordinate.description: Specific methods used to physically move the treated fabric and carry away dirt.

idea: A garment chamber where clothes are exposed to precisely tuned RF or microwave fields. The frequency and power are optimized to selectively heat and slightly expand/soften the dirt particles or the interface layer between dirt and fabric, without significantly heating the fabric itself. This localized thermal stress, combined with gentle mechanical tumbling or air currents, causes the dirt to lose adhesion and be dislodged. A filtration system then collects the removed particles, providing a water-free cleaning method.

purpose.label: Dirt removal enhancement

purpose.label: Water conservation

superordinate.label: Closed-loop resource recovery

basic.label: Chelation and dispersion via humic substances
basic.description: The use of humic compounds to act as chelating and dispersing agents that bind to oils, metals, and dirt.

basic.label: Recycling system with separation optimization
basic.description: A purification system specifically designed to separate the humic-dirt complexes from the water for reuse.

subordinate.label: Engineered humic acid analogues
subordinate.description: Specific biodegradable compounds used as the active cleaning agent.

idea: A low-water washing system that uses a mild, biodegradable solution containing engineered humic acid analogues or naturally derived humic substances. These compounds act as powerful chelating and dispersing agents, effectively binding to dirt, oils, and metal ions embedded in fabric. This complexation process makes the contaminants easier to rinse away with a minimal amount of water, which is then purified and recycled through a system optimized to separate the humic-dirt complexes.

subordinate.label: Array of micro-jets or pulsators
subordinate.description: Specific hardware used to generate the localized air movements.

idea: A sealed garment cleaning chamber where clothes are suspended. An array of micro-jets or pulsators generates highly localized, tunable air pressure pulsations around individual fabric fibers. Dislodged particles are then quietly drawn into a filter system by a very gentle, continuous background flow.

purpose.label: Dirt adhesion weakening

superordinate.label: Chemical solubilization/emulsification

subordinate.label: Targeted spray or minimal-water immersion
subordinate.description: Application via a targeted spray or immersion system using minimal water.

idea: A targeted spray or minimal-water immersion system utilizing specific, non-toxic, fabric-safe plant-derived phytochemicals that are known to solubilize or emulsify fatty/waxy substances, similar to how plant cuticles are degraded. These agents would weaken the adhesion of oily dirt and grime to fabric fibers, allowing for easy removal with minimal water rinsing or wiping, without relying on broad-spectrum enzymes or microbes.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via thermal shock

purpose.label: Water conservation

superordinate.label: Phase change cleaning
superordinate.description: Utilizing the high energy state of a gaseous solvent (vapor) to interact with contaminants rather than liquid immersion.

superordinate.label: Closed-loop circulation
superordinate.description: Recovering the solvent after use to maintain a constant supply without replenishment.

basic.description: Generating and circulating vapor without liquid droplets to impact garments.

basic.label: Condensation and filtration recycling
basic.description: Cooling vapor back to liquid, filtering contaminants, and returning it to the reservoir.

The steam then cools, condenses, and is immediately collected, filtered, and returned to the reservoir for continuous reuse, achieving powerful cleaning with extremely low water replenishment.

purpose.label: Remove contaminants without washing

idea: Garments are treated with a dissolvable or detachable nanocoating that has a stronger affinity for dirt/oils than for fabric fibers. A mild, fabric-safe trigger (e.g., a specific light wavelength, a slight humidity change, or a very mild vibration) causes the nanocoating to rapidly delaminate or de-bond from the fabric, encapsulating and releasing the accumulated dirt. The shed nanocoating and dirt particles are then collected by a vacuum and filter system, leaving clean fabric with no water.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via surface interaction

Interdigitated electrodes on the surface generate high-frequency SAWs that propagate along the interface with the fabric. These SAWs exert precise, localized mechanical forces on dirt particles at the fabric surface, effectively "sweeping" or "vibrating" them off without needing bulk water, solvents, or bulk ultrasonic cavitation. The dislodged dirt is collected by an integrated vacuum system.

purpose.label: Particulate removal without solvent

superordinate.label: Electrostatic manipulation

idea: Design fabrics or fabric liners with embedded electret properties. purpose.label: Deep particulate extraction

basic.label: Penetrating micro-projection scrubbing

As garments are gently tumbled or brushed against these surfaces, the micro-needles penetrate the weave, physically lifting and extracting deeply embedded dirt, dust, and particulate matter from the fabric pores without requiring water or harsh chemicals.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal from textiles

superordinate.label: Selective affinity capture and triggered release

basic.label: Bio-scaffold particle encapsulation

subordinate.label: Decellularized bio-scaffold particles

idea: A system that applies a fine mist containing microscopic, biodegradable, decellularized bio-scaffold particles onto clothes. These particles are engineered to have a high affinity for common organic dirt and odors. After a short dwell time in a low-humidity environment, a mild trigger (e.g., specific light, very gentle vibration) initiates the controlled degradation or detachment of the bio-scaffold, taking the encapsulated dirt and odor molecules with it into a collection system, leaving clean garments with minimal water usage.

purpose.label: Reuse laundry wastewater

subordinate.label: Concentrated draw solution & FO membrane

idea: A washing machine integrated with a forward osmosis system. After an initial, minimal-water wash cycle, the greywater (feed solution) is pumped to one side of an FO membrane. A highly concentrated, reusable draw solution is on the other side. Clean water is naturally pulled from the greywater through the membrane, leaving all contaminants and dirt in the concentrated feed solution, and the purified water is then recycled back into the wash system for continuous reuse, drastically reducing fresh water consumption.

purpose.label: Dry contaminant removal

basic.label: Air cushion suspension

purpose.label: Localized stain removal

superordinate.label: Precision application and extraction

basic.label: Encapsulating micro-droplet injection and vacuum removal

subordinate.label: Mild vacuum or absorbent pad

idea: A precision stain removal device that generates and applies microscopic, targeted droplets of a highly concentrated, fabric-safe cleaning agent. Each droplet is designed to penetrate and then encapsulate a specific dirt particle or stain molecule. After a short dwell time, a mild vacuum or absorbent pad removes these dirt-encapsulating droplets, providing highly localized and efficient stain removal with minimal liquid use, preventing spreading and eliminating the need for a full wash.

purpose.label: Particulate and dry contaminant removal
purpose.description: Removing fine dust, lint, and superficial dirt from fabric without using water.

superordinate.label: Physical force field manipulation
superordinate.description: Using an induced external force field gradient to physically separate particles from a substrate.

basic.label: Thermophoresis
basic.description: Utilizing a temperature gradient to create a thermophoretic force that drives particles from warmer regions (fabric) to cooler regions (collection plate).

subordinate.label: Heating and cooling system with collection plate
subordinate.description: A sealed cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with mechanisms to heat the fabric and cool a collection plate to establish the necessary temperature gradient.

idea: A sealed garment cabinet or tumbling drum equipped with a heating and cooling system to create a controlled temperature gradient across the fabric surface in a dry environment. As garments are gently tumbled or suspended, the temperature gradient induces thermophoretic forces that gently drive fine dust, lint, and superficial particulate dirt away from the warmer fabric surface towards a colder collection plate or filter, effectively removing dry contaminants without water.

purpose.label: Waterless garment refreshing

superordinate.label: Non-mechanical fluid dynamic displacement

basic.label: Air filtration and capture

subordinate.label: Garment refreshing cabinet

idea: A garment refreshing cabinet where an internal electric field generates a controlled "ion wind" or electrohydrodynamic flow. This silent, gentle, localized air current is directed across the fabric surfaces, physically dislodging dry dust, lint, and carrying away odor molecules without any moving mechanical parts. The dislodged particles and odors are then collected by an integrated filter and purification system, providing a water-free and gentle cleaning method.

purpose.label: Waterless contaminant removal

superordinate.label: Tunable surface adhesion
superordinate.description: Exploiting reversible adhesive properties to alternately capture contaminants from one surface and release them to another.

basic.label: Stimulus-responsive surface energy modulation
basic.description: Using external stimuli to dynamically alter the surface energy of a material to switch between sticky (cleaning) and non-sticky (releasing) states.

subordinate.label: Smart polymer rollers
subordinate.description: Rollers constructed from a polymer material capable of changing properties.

subordinate.label: Light wavelength stimuli
subordinate.description: Using specific light wavelengths as the trigger to change the material's adhesion.

idea: A dry-cleaning appliance featuring rollers made from a "smart" polymer whose surface energy can be tuned. As garments pass through, a mild stimulus (e.g., a specific light wavelength) temporarily increases the roller's adhesion, causing it to pick up dirt and oils from the fabric. A different stimulus then reduces the adhesion, causing the collected dirt to release from the roller into a waste receptacle, making the roller self-cleaning and reusable for continuous water-free garment cleaning.

purpose.label: Dislodge dirt particles from fabric structure
purpose.description: Mechanically freeing particulate matter trapped within the weave of the garment.

superordinate.label: Volumetric expansion of material matrix
superordinate.description: Generating internal mechanical forces to displace foreign matter by physically expanding the volume of the substrate components.

basic.label: Stimuli-responsive fiber swelling
basic.description: Fibers woven into the fabric that physically expand and contract in reaction to specific triggers (like mist or pH) to push dirt out.

subordinate.label: pH or humidity-sensitive polymers
subordinate.description: Specific material class used to create the responsive fibers.

idea: Garments are woven with a percentage of specialized, micro-scale stimuli-responsive fibers (e.g., pH or humidity-sensitive polymers). When the garment is exposed to a minimal, fine mist of water with a specific pH, these embedded fibers swell, physically pushing outwards and dislodging dirt particles from the fabric structure. A subsequent change (e.g., mild heating or pH neutralization) causes the fibers to shrink, releasing the loosened dirt, which is then removed by a gentle airflow and filtration system, achieving cleaning with very low water input.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via solvent extraction
purpose.description: The specific intervention of removing hydrophobic dirt and oils from the fabric weave without traditional washing agitation.

purpose.label: Resource recovery
purpose.description: The goal of capturing and reusing the cleaning medium to minimize loss.

superordinate.label: Gas-phase solvency
superordinate.description: Utilizing the high diffusivity and penetration capability of a substance in its gaseous state to access deep fibers where liquid might not reach as efficiently.

superordinate.label: Closed-loop separation
superordinate.description: Maintaining a sealed environment where the cleaning agent can be chemically separated from the waste and returned to the system.

basic.label: Localized gaseous solvent injection
basic.description: Injecting micro-bursts of a low-boiling-point solvent gas directly into the fabric to dissolve contaminants.

basic.label: Vacuum extraction and condensation cycle

subordinate.label: Micro-nozzle system
subordinate.description: The specific hardware used to deliver the micro-bursts of solvent.

subordinate.label: Sealed chamber
subordinate.description: The containment unit that allows for the vacuum and condensation process.

idea: A sealed laundry chamber where garments are held taut. A system of micro-nozzles precisely injects localized micro-bursts of a fabric-safe, miscible, low-boiling-point solvent (in its gas phase) directly into the fabric weave. This gaseous solvent deeply penetrates and dissolves hydrophobic dirt and oils. A gentle, continuous vacuum then pulls the dirt-laden gas out, which is subsequently condensed, purified, and recycled for continuous reuse, providing highly targeted and water-free cleaning.

purpose.label: Dirt removal via low-moisture medium
purpose.description: To clean garments by lifting and emulsifying dirt without submerging them in bulk liquid.

purpose.label: Effluent minimization

superordinate.label: Surface area maximization

superordinate.label: Phase change separation

basic.label: Dense foam cleaning
basic.description: Agitating a mixture of surfactants and minimal water to create a stable foam that serves as the primary mechanical and chemical cleaning agent.

basic.label: Foam collapse and filtration
basic.description: Destabilizing the cleaning medium to return it to a liquid state for containment and purification.

subordinate.label: Biodegradable biosurfactant
subordinate.description: The specific chemical agent used to generate the foam.

subordinate.label: Tumbling chamber

subordinate.label: Filtration recycling system

idea: A low-water washing system that utilizes a highly concentrated, yet gentle, biodegradable biosurfactant foam. Garments are placed in a chamber where a precise, minimal amount of water, cleaning agents, and biosurfactant is agitated to create a dense, stable foam. Clothes are gently tumbled through this foam, allowing the biosurfactants to lift and emulsify dirt with minimal bulk water. The foam is then collapsed, and the concentrated dirty liquid is filtered and recycled, or collected for disposal, significantly reducing water volume.

purpose.label: Waterless particle removal
purpose.description: To dislodge and remove dry dust, lint, and fine particles from fabric without using water.

superordinate.label: Aerodynamic and thermodynamic agitation
superordinate.description: Utilizing the physical forces of moving air combined with temperature gradients to physically separate contaminants from surfaces.

basic.label: Vortex tube air streams

subordinate.label: Sealed garment cabinet
subordinate.description: A containment unit where clothes are suspended for treatment.

subordinate.label: Compressed air source
subordinate.description: Feeds the system to drive the vortex tubes.

subordinate.label: Collection filter
subordinate.description: Traps the particles pushed away from the fabric.

idea: A sealed garment cabinet where clothes are suspended. Compressed air is fed into an array of miniature vortex tubes directed at the garments. The resulting high-velocity, temperature-differentiated air streams create targeted aerodynamic forces to dislodge dry dust and lint (mechanical cleaning) and simultaneously generate localized thermophoretic effects, pushing fine particles away from the fabric towards a collection filter. This provides a dry, water-free, and energy-efficient cleaning process.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal and deodorization

superordinate.label: Molecular bond disruption
superordinate.description: Breaking down contaminants at a chemical level into removable byproducts rather than dissolving them.

basic.label: Electron beam irradiation
basic.description: Using a controlled low-energy electron beam to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic contaminants.

subordinate.label: Vacuum extraction system

idea: A specialized garment refresh chamber where clothes are briefly exposed to a controlled, low-energy electron beam. The electron beam's energy is tuned to target and disrupt the molecular bonds of organic dirt, oils, and odor-causing compounds on the fabric surface. These contaminants are then converted into volatile byproducts or easily detachable fragments that are removed by a gentle vacuum system, providing a deep, dry, and chemical-free surface cleaning and deodorization, minimizing the need for water washes.

purpose.label: Contaminant solubilization for low-rinse removal
purpose.description: Targeting the chemical bond between contaminants and fabric to allow for removal with minimal water volume.

superordinate.label: Selective chemical binding (Chelation)
superordinate.description: Exploiting the ability of specific agents to form strong bonds with target ions or molecules, altering their solubility or adhesion properties without relying on high solvent volume.

basic.label: Fabric-safe chelating mist application

basic.label: Filtration-based waste recovery

subordinate.label: Marine-derived chelating agents

idea: A garment cleaning system that employs a fine mist of water containing specialized, fabric-safe, marine-derived or inspired chelating agents. These agents are designed to selectively bind to metallic ions, mineral deposits (e.g., from hard water stains), and certain organic pollutants commonly found in dirt and stains. Once chelated, the contaminants become more soluble or easily dislodged, allowing for effective removal with significantly reduced water rinsing, which is then filtered to remove the chelated compounds for safe disposal or recovery.

purpose.label: Contaminant removal
purpose.description: To physically remove dirt, oils, and stains from the fabric surface.

superordinate.label: Selective energy absorption
superordinate.description: Exploiting the difference in how contaminants and fabric fibers absorb specific types of energy to target only the unwanted material.

basic.label: Laser ablation
basic.description: Using precise light pulses to cause rapid micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of contaminants.

basic.label: Optical targeting
basic.description: Using sensors to identify soiled areas for precise application of the cleaning mechanism.

basic.label: Suction extraction

subordinate.label: Low-power, pulsed laser system
subordinate.description: The specific device used to generate the ablating energy.

subordinate.label: Optical sensors
subordinate.description: The hardware used to locate stains.

subordinate.label: Gentle vacuum
subordinate.description: The device used to remove the vaporized or decomposed debris.

idea: A garment cleaning station equipped with a low-power, pulsed laser system. Optical sensors identify soiled areas, and the laser is precisely tuned (wavelength, pulse energy) to be selectively absorbed by common dirt, oils, or stain chromophores. The absorbed energy causes rapid, localized micro-vaporization or thermal decomposition of the contaminant, effectively "ablating" it from the fabric surface without heating or damaging the surrounding fibers. A gentle vacuum collects the resulting microscopic debris, providing an extremely targeted, water-free, and residue-free cleaning method.

purpose.label: Dirt and odor matrix breakdown

superordinate.label: Chemical destabilization of adhesion

basic.label: Biofilm-dispersing agent application

basic.label: Non-aqueous contaminant removal

subordinate.label: Enzymes, natural dispersants, or bacteriophages
subordinate.description: Specific active ingredients used in the mixture.

subordinate.label: Damp cloth or gentle air current/filtration
subordinate.description: Specific mechanisms for lifting away the broken-down residue.

idea: A targeted spray or fine mist system that applies a fabric-safe mixture of biofilm-dispersing enzymes, mild natural dispersants, or lytic bacteriophages onto garments. This treatment specifically breaks down the sticky matrix of microbial biofilms and the embedded dirt/odor compounds, allowing them to be easily wiped away with a damp cloth or lifted by a gentle air current and filtration system, significantly reducing the need for bulk water washing to eliminate persistent smells and grime.

purpose.label: Contaminant dislodgement
purpose.description: Breaking the bond between dirt particles and fabric fibers without water.

purpose.label: Particle removal

subordinate.label: Embedded micro-electrodes

subordinate.label: Filtration system
subordinate.description: Mechanism to capture particles removed by the vacuum.

idea: A specialized laundry drum or cabinet with embedded micro-electrodes near the fabric surface. When clothes are present, a precisely controlled, short, high-energy electrical pulse is applied. This generates localized, micro-scale mechanical shockwaves within the fabric itself or at the fabric-dirt interface, effectively breaking the adhesive bonds of embedded dirt and grime without damaging the fibers. The dislodged particles are then removed by a gentle vacuum and filtration system, providing a water-free cleaning method that targets deeply embedded contaminants.

purpose.label: Dirt extraction from fabric

superordinate.label: Interfacial adhesion separation

subordinate.label: Microscopic air bubbles
subordinate.description: Fine bubbles introduced into the solution.

subordinate.label: Specialized mildly aqueous solution
subordinate.description: The minimal volume liquid medium used for immersion.

subordinate.label: Froth skimming/filtration system
subordinate.description: Mechanism to remove the dirt-laden foam from the surface.

idea: A low-water garment cleaning chamber where clothes are immersed in a minimal volume of specialized, mildly aqueous solution. Fine, microscopic air bubbles are then introduced into the solution. These bubbles are engineered to selectively adhere to hydrophobic dirt, oils, and grease particles embedded in the fabric. The dirt-laden bubbles rise to the surface, forming a stable "froth" that is continuously skimmed off and filtered, effectively extracting contaminants from the garments with extremely low water usage and minimal mechanical agitation. The cleaned water is then recirculated.

purpose.label: Remove volatile contaminants from fabric

superordinate.label: Thermal desorption

basic.label: Controlled low-heat in inert atmosphere
basic.description: Heating clothes gently in a dry, inert environment to vaporize contaminants without damaging fibers, combined with airflow to transport the vapor away.

subordinate.label: Sealed cabinet with filtration/catalytic unit
subordinate.description: A garment cabinet equipped with heating elements and a filtration or catalytic oxidation unit to capture the volatilized contaminants.

idea: A sealed garment cabinet designed to gently heat clothes to a precisely controlled, low temperature in a dry, inert atmosphere. This controlled heating causes volatile odor-causing compounds, body oils, and light organic residues embedded in the fabric to desorb (vaporize) from the fibers. A continuous, gentle airflow then carries these volatilized contaminants to a filtration or catalytic oxidation unit for capture and safe breakdown, effectively refreshing and deodorizing garments without the use of water or chemicals, extending wear time between wet washes.

purpose.label: Stain removal

superordinate.label: Targeted application
superordinate.description: Applying cleaning agents only where necessary to minimize resource usage.

superordinate.label: Phase-change removal

idea: A smart appliance or handheld device that uses optical sensors to detect stains. It then precisely "inkjets" micro-droplets of a concentrated, fabric-safe cleaning solution onto the stain. purpose.label: Dirt and Biofilm Detachment
purpose.description: To disrupt the integrity of microbial biofilms and weaken the cohesive bonds of embedded dirt particles so they can be removed.

superordinate.label: Electrophysical Disruption
superordinate.description: Using electrical energy to physically destabilize biological structures and particle adhesion forces rather than relying solely on chemical solubility or mechanical force.

basic.label: Pulsed Electric Field Application

subordinate.label: Minimal-Water Chamber
